# factory-widgets.service
[Unit]
Description=factory triage + dispatcher for acme/widgets (one pass)

[Service]
Type=oneshot
WorkingDirectory=/srv/widgets
Environment=PATH=/opt/bin:/usr/bin
Environment="POLICY=24 hours 50%%"
Environment=GH_CONFIG_DIR=/machine/gh
ExecStart=-/opt/factory/bin/python -P -m factory triage
ExecStart=/opt/factory/bin/python -P -m factory dispatch
ExecStopPost=-/opt/factory/bin/python -P -m factory watch

# factory-widgets.timer
[Unit]
Description=Run the factory pass for acme/widgets every 10min

[Timer]
OnBootSec=5min
OnUnitActiveSec=10min
RandomizedDelaySec=90

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

# factory-widgets-dashboard.service
[Unit]
Description=factory dashboard for acme/widgets
After=network.target

[Service]
WorkingDirectory=/srv/widgets
Environment=PATH=/opt/bin:/usr/bin
Environment="POLICY=24 hours 50%%"
ExecStart=/opt/factory/bin/python -P -m factory dashboard --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8765 --no-open
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target

# factory-widgets-triage-probe.service
[Unit]
Description=Probe the triage model for acme/widgets

[Service]
Type=oneshot
WorkingDirectory=/srv/widgets
Environment=PATH=/opt/bin:/usr/bin
Environment="POLICY=24 hours 50%%"
ExecStart=/opt/factory/bin/python -P -m factory triage-probe

# factory-widgets-triage-probe.timer
[Unit]
Description=Probe the triage model for acme/widgets every 2 minutes

[Timer]
OnBootSec=2min
OnUnitActiveSec=2min
RandomizedDelaySec=30

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

# factory-widgets-eval.service
[Unit]
Description=Run the frozen worker eval suite for acme/widgets

[Service]
Type=oneshot
WorkingDirectory=/srv/widgets
Environment=PATH=/opt/bin:/usr/bin
Environment="POLICY=24 hours 50%%"
ExecStart=/opt/factory/bin/python -P -m factory eval --profile prime --scheduled

# factory-widgets-eval.timer
[Unit]
Description=Run the frozen worker eval suite for acme/widgets weekly

[Timer]
OnCalendar=weekly
Persistent=true
RandomizedDelaySec=30min

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
